text.tspan: FRC 1.13 µm; published ML-HDR 8 bit: 7-1, FRC 2.42 µm; ML + mask 8 bit: 8-6, FRC 1.03 µm. The published Eq. 14–15 reconstruction oscillates between iterations (SD of log error over the last 25 % of samples 0.069 vs 0.035 for LRFC-style HDR).

text.style: fill: #333333; font: 8.6px 'Times New Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Reconstruction: our pure-NumPy mPIE (250 iterations), not the PtyLab engine of the recorded experiment; PtyLab defaults except alpha_probe = 1.0, plus probe centre-of-mass stabilisation. Smallest resolved element and FRC — single 8 bit: 7-1, FRC 2.02 µm; single 16 bit: 9-1, FRC 0.80 µm; LRFC-style HDR 8 bit: 8-6,

text.style: fill: #333333; font: 8.6px 'Times New Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: reconstructions), van Heel half-bit threshold; cutoff labels give dx / cutoff (half-period). A crossing at the first ring ≥ 0.05 Nyquist (≥ 9.88 µm) means no resolution (a floor) and is not drawn as a cutoff. Images, profiles, error histories and FRC curves are single runs (seed 0).

text.tspan: (g) Object-amplitude NRMSE vs ground truth; 'Time' = mPIE wall-clock until log error first enters its plateau (within max(0.02, 2 SD) of the median of the last 25 % of samples); no time is shown when the error never drops (our CPU with parallel workers). (h) FRC against the GROUND TRUTH (not two independent

text.style: fill: #333333; font: 8.6px 'Times New Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Dashed cyan box = smallest element resolved together with all coarser elements in both orientations (3 distinct profile minima inside the 3 bar regions (±0.25 px) and worst-case Michelson contrast ≥ 0.2; profile averaged over the central 60% of the bar length; threshold 0.2), read from resolution_summary.json.

text.style: fill: #333333; font: 8.6px 'Times New Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Synthetic USAF-1951 groups 7–9 (bars |O| = 0.15 on 1.0); 8-bit ADC unless stated; (b) is the ground truth (the paper shows an optical-microscope image here). Paper Fig. 6 is an EXPERIMENT; this is a simulation. All panels share one gray range.

text.style: fill: #333333; font: 8.6px 'Times New Roman', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Adapted simulation: our detector, object sampling and propagation distance differ from the paper; parameters are recorded in meta.json. Our LRFC-style linear-response baseline selects the longest unsaturated exposure per pixel; this selection rule is our implementation choice.
